units.rawText: Other than you, very few people appreciate my old-fashioned pastries. I learned to make them from an elderly woman, who was like family to me.

units.rawText: As times change and all kinds of new, trendy things emerge relentlessly one after the other, many old things are also slowly forgotten, until they disappear from history altogether.

units.rawText: However, I want to preserve them because these things are the embodiment of millennia of sentimentality.
